schema.label: string (Trojan or Trojan-Free)
schema.suspect_nodes: array of strings (hierarchical node names from design.v)

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of Trojan-infected netlists correctly labeled as 'Trojan'.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of Trojan-free netlists incorrectly labeled as 'Trojan'.

metrics.name: node_identification_accuracy
metrics.description: Jaccard similarity between the submitted suspect_nodes set and the ground truth suspect set.
